SIMPLE ENGLISH
Kanban visualizes workflow, controls work in progress (WIP) and improves flow. It need not
use fixed-length sprints.

WIP limit = 2

Expected result: A visible bottleneck encourages finishing work; cycle time measures elapsed
time through the selected workflow.

Q: Kanban vs Scrum?
A: Kanban optimizes flow with WIP limits; Scrum organizes work around Sprints and defined
accountabilities/events.

Memory trick
Stop starting; start finishing.
